title: Campbell, Grossman, Wang (1993) Trading volume and serial correlation in stock returns
note: Daily return autocorrelation turns more negative on high-volume days. Rule to try: after a down close on above-median tick volume (20d), long US500/US100 to next close; check DAX, Nikkei same params. Different from Baltussen MAC5 (rejected): volume-conditioned. Need post-2018 evidence in the paper or replication.

title: Gervais, Kaniel, Mingelgrin (2001) The high-volume return premium
note: Unusually high volume days/weeks predict higher returns the next 1-4 weeks (visibility). Index/gold version: long after 20d-max tick-volume day. Pair with campbell lead; opposite sign to reversal so read both and keep the one with a post-2018 result.

title: Kamstra, Kramer, Levi (2003) Winter blues: SAD and stock market cycles
note: Seasonal-affective-disorder effect: weak autumn, strong winter equity returns, bigger at high latitudes. Test on US500, US100, GER40, UK100, JP225 with one rule (long after the autumn equinox to the winter solstice+). Weeks+ horizon, uncorrelated with intraday legs. Check for replication after 2010 before queueing.

title: Brown and Cliff (2004) Investor sentiment and near-term stock market
note: Sentiment extremes (here CBOE equity put/call ratio, free CSV on cboe.com historical data) vs next 1-4 week index returns. Data item needed; check the file runs to 2025 before queueing. Contrarian rule on US500/US100, weekly.

title: CBOE SKEW extreme as a crash-hedge signal for gold and US500 (volidx/SKEW ready)
note: Data is already in marketdata/volidx. Rule: when SKEW is above its 252d 90th percentile, go long XAUUSD (hedge) for 5 days and flat US500. Aims at months when the book loses. No paper; needs same params on 2 markets (XAUUSD, USDJPY short) to be admitted. Memory search first (volidx SKEW).

title: Blose and Gondhalekar (2013) Weekend effect in gold returns around the world
note: Gold shows low Monday returns, high Friday. Rule on XAUUSD, XAGUSD: short Friday close to Monday close or long Wed-Fri. Needs post-2013 evidence; FTMO swap cost over weekend counts (triple swap Wednesday for gold).

title: Karnaukh, Ranaldo, Soderlind (2015) Understanding FX liquidity
note: FX liquidity (spread) commonality and its link to volatility and funding. Use the FTMO terminal spread history (tools/export_mt5_data.py) as a liquidity proxy: after spread widening vs 20d median on EURUSD, fade the 4h move. Checks whether a spread-shock reversal exists on EURUSD, GBPUSD, USDJPY with one parameter set.

title: EURGBP range mean reversion (Bollinger 20, 2 sd, H4) with AUDNZD and EURCHF as the same-parameter check
note: Low-vol crosses that range. Need a named EA on CodeBase with source (open the list, pick one Bollinger reversion on H4). Not the audnz_cadchf bollinger item already done: cross is EURGBP. Must run on 3 crosses with same params.

title: One pooled meta-label model across all intraday legs (leg id, hour, ATR ratio, gap, spread as features)
note: Closest rejected: per-leg meta-labels (ml_meta_label_breakout etc., small samples). This one pools trades of fix, cross, after, morning, fall, noise, quartet so n is 5-10x larger, target = trade pnl > 0 net of costs, past-only features, expanding-window logistic or LightGBM, skip trade when p < 0.45. Own leg: all intraday legs.

title: Quantile-regression exit targets for breakout and noise legs (predict 60th pct of MFE from entry features)
note: Target = max favourable excursion in the leg's hold window; take profit at predicted quantile, past-only features (ATR ratio, gap, range-to-date, hour). Use is exit, not entry, so differs from the rejected daily direction ML. Own leg: breakout, noise.

title: Trend-day versus range-day classifier from the first hours (Dalton, Mind over Markets) gating breakout, noise and grid
note: Label a day trend when close-open exceeds 0.6 of range; features known at 09:00 server: Asian range/20d, gap, prior-day type, VIX level. Enable breakout/noise on predicted trend days, grid on range days. Closest rejected: ml_regime_grid / hmm_regime_grid (HMM on daily returns); this uses a supervised label and intraday features.

title: PPO exit-timing policy for existing intraday entries (state: minutes since entry, MFE, MAE, ATR; action hold/exit)
note: Entries stay the legs' own; RL only decides exit with cost in the reward. Closest rejected: deep RL replications and DQN on 20 futures (they chose entries). Seed-stability check mandatory (5 seeds). Own leg: after, fall, morning.

title: Lo-MacKinlay variance ratio gate on the AUDCAD grid
note: Only run the grid when the 5-day variance ratio of AUDCAD over the past 120 days is below 1 (mean-reverting). A statistical test, not an HMM; closest rejected hmm_regime_grid / ml_regime_grid. Check on NZDCAD, AUDNZD with the same window if the grid exists there.

title: Hurst exponent switch between breakout and grid legs
note: Rolling Hurst (R/S, 100 days) above 0.55 enables breakout weight, below 0.45 enables grid weight. Sizing between existing legs only. Rule must work on 3 markets with the same window; check losing months list in gaps.json for improvement.
